import pandas as pd, numpy as np

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.signal import medfilt
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
P=d.pivot_table(index='shift_cm1',columns=['config','angle_deg'],values='intensity')
x=P.index.values
# isolated-spike detection: point minus local median(7) relative to robust noise, flagged if neighbours are not elevated
spikes=[]
for col in P.columns:
    y=P[col].values
    med=medfilt(y,7)
    r=y-med
    noise=1.4826*np.median(np.abs(r-np.median(r)))
    idx=np.where(r>10*noise)[0]
    for i in idx:
        # isolated: neighbours (i-1,i+1) elevated less than half the excess
        nb=[y[j] for j in (i-1,i+1) if 0<=j<len(y)]
        if max(nb)-med[i] < 0.5*(y[i]-med[i]):
            spikes.append((col,x[i],round(y[i]),round(med[i])))
print('isolated spikes:',len(spikes))
for s in spikes: print(s)
print('noise sigma approx (parallel 0deg, 200-300 region):', 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(np.diff(P[('parallel',0)].loc[200:300].values)))/np.sqrt(2))
EOF
